parsed.name: Delta Elektronika 单通道可编程直流电源
parsed.name_en: Delta Elektronika single-channel programmable DC power supply
parsed.description: 通过 PSC-ETH-2 以太网接口通信的单通道可编程直流电源，可用于实验中提供和调节输出电压、电流，并配置电压/电流限制以及保存、调用设备设置。
parsed.description_en: A single-channel programmable DC power supply accessed via the PSC-ETH-2 Ethernet interface. It is used in laboratory setups to source and adjust output voltage and current, configure voltage/current limits, and save or recall instrument settings.
